content: River (Go, Postgres-backed job queue): built-in retry with exponential backoff (attempts^4 +/- jitter, default max 25 attempts); ScheduledAt for future execution; periodic/cron jobs; batch insert via Postgres COPY FROM; multiple named queues with isolated worker pools; jobs insertable in the same transaction as other DB changes (transactional enqueue) eliminating dual-write. Dashboard (River UI): cancel/retry/delete jobs, pause queues, adjust concurrency (Pro). Notably a job queue, not a multi-step workflow engine -- no built-in step sequencing/state machine, which is the gap entflow targets while remaining compatible as an optional backend.
